headline: Magmarex Build
title: Magmarex Build | Lava Breath and Burning Sun | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Magmarex is a Fire breaker with huge break and health. Its Lava Breath applies Fire Debuff stacks. Then Lava Punch spends those stacks for extra damage, and Burning Sun hits harder for every stack on the target. Magma Surge can stun a target that carries many stacks. Raise break first, then health. The Gargantuan Horn boosts break, and Flamerion is a great partner. Do you run Magmarex? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Magmarex build: Fire breaker that stacks Fire Debuff with Lava Breath and spends it with Lava Punch and Burning Sun. Raise Break then HP, Gargantuan Horn, Flamerion partner.
joke: This one runs so hot the stacks arrive pre-cooked.
